note: Captured from the CHR test router. Both tasks were created FOR the capture, DISABLED so neither ran, and removed afterwards: one daily at a time of day, one at startup. What is real is the reply's shape, and one fact worth keeping: a task added without a policy is given EVERY policy (policy and sensitive included), which is why a non-empty on-event is held to the code gate even on a create. A disabled task carries no next-run. Read through /system/scheduler/print; tools/capture-fixtures.js cannot capture an area.
